title: Cases in which statement of relevant fact by person who is dead or cannot be found, etc., is relevant (Dying declaration)
text:
Section 32. Cases in which statement of relevant fact by person who is dead or cannot be found, etc., is relevant.
Statements, written or verbal, of relevant facts made by a person who is dead, or who cannot be found, or who has become incapable of giving evidence, are themselves relevant facts in the circumstances set forth herein.
